name: ue-perfectworld
description: Project-neutral Codex workflows for Unreal Engine stage-gated development (S0-S6 requirement intake, evidence base, change specification, implementation, verification, review, delivery), plus investigation, Blueprint collaboration, and development documentation.

interface.shortDescription: 通用 UE 项目的规划、实现、审查、排查和蓝图协作规则。
interface.longDescription: UE PerfectWorld provides project-neutral Unreal Engine workflows that require evidence-backed ownership and lifecycle discovery, keep workspaces read-only until direct edits are authorized, and enforce a blocking final self-review before delivery. When UE Project RAG is installed, it uses cited retrieval results only to accelerate project evidence discovery.
defaultPrompt: 用 UE PerfectWorld 规划这个 Unreal Engine 功能
用 UE PerfectWorld 排查这个 UE bug 的根因
用 UE PerfectWorld 审查当前 UE 代码
